contract.design_owner: Independent neutral source-only forward test author

swift-clamp.value: The Swift displayCount getter clamps count to a minimum of zero.

swift-delegation.value: The Swift label getter passes displayCount to the supplied formatter.

kotlin-clamp.value: The Kotlin displayCount getter clamps count to a minimum of zero.

kotlin-delegation.value: The Kotlin label getter passes displayCount to the supplied formatter.

kotlin-empty-fallback.value: The Kotlin label getter contains an in-body replacement for empty formatter output.

shared-identifier.value: Both model declarations expose the source constant neutral.badge.count as accessibilityIdentifier.

formatter-localization.value: The configured formatter implementations resolve their label through localization resource key badge.count.

source_audit.clause: The Swift component derives a nonnegative display count.
The Swift component delegates label creation using its derived count.
The Kotlin component derives a nonnegative display count.
The Kotlin component delegates label creation using its derived count.
The Kotlin label getter preserves the supplied formatter result.
The source identifier constant is shared across both model declarations.
Configured formatter implementations must resolve the independent localization key.

trust_limit: Identity and exact typed derivation only. Authorship, design correctness and approval require a separate preimplementation review record.
